regions.label: INES_Header
regions.evidence: NES magic and parsed iNES header: 2 PRG units, 4 CHR units, mapper 3 CNROM; matches rom.info.

regions.label: CHR_TileBanks
regions.evidence: iNES CHR extent: four 8 KiB CNROM pattern banks; physical PPU tile storage, separate from CPU executable PRG. Runtime renders title and five event backgrounds from this storage.

regions.label: InterruptVectors
regions.evidence: Three little-endian CPU vectors at $FFFA-$FFFF: NMI $FB74, Reset $F9F9, IRQ $FFF0. IRQ targets uniform FF sentinel; pointer does not prove IRQ code.

regions.label: TaskHandlerPointers
regions.evidence: CPU $FA9D-$FAA9 loads word at $FABC+Y and indirect-jumps. Scheduler iterates exactly 8 slots ($0308=0..7), Y=slot*2; therefore eight handler addresses. Connected contract decoded in analysis/round-001/connected-disassembly.txt.

regions.label: ScreenRecords
regions.evidence: Six 6-byte records consumed by $8639: $A1*6 selects PPU control, palette selector, PPU script pointer, and handler pointer. Proven selectors 0..5 set by menu and completion paths; exact word targets inspected in screen-N-decode.json. Extent claim limited to this finite domain.

regions.label: UploadedAPUStoreTemplate
regions.evidence: $EFFD-$F008 copies exactly physical $7025-$7028 into RAM $01C6-$01C9 using source $F014+Y for Y=4..1. Template is STA $4000; RTS, its operand low byte patched at $01C7. Observed RAM fetches remain RAM identity. Static ROM template contract, not natural direct execution at $F015.

regions.label: MenuAndTextData
regions.evidence: Repeated PPU command prefixes ($20-$23), run counts, tiled patterns and encoded text alphabet; consumers queue script pointers through $FC81 and parse at $FCE2. Boundary after preceding screen routines and before event-init code. Checked 256-byte windows and connected code references; no conflicting code starts. Generic Data classification does not claim one complete script schema.

regions.label: GraphicsRecordData

Helper code ends RTS at physical $4509; sound engine begins $68A0. Bounded all-256-byte-window sample review and referenced consumers (sprite/PPU routines) support non-code throughout; precise subobject schemas deferred.

Generic Data; track schemas/individual bounds remain unresolved.
